expected_root_cause: TextFormatter calls Error or String directly while formatting values. A panicking method or a typed-nil pointer behind the interface can panic the entire logging path instead of being rendered safely.
fix_summary: Wrap error and Stringer formatting in recovery helpers and render typed-nil values as <nil> while preserving a diagnostic panic marker for other panics.
curation_notes: The PR changelog identifies the v1.10.0 formatting regression and its regression tests cover panicable error, Stringer, and typed-nil values.
